title: Federal EPR could cut waste management costs in half: WWF
summary: Producer compliance costs could be roughly halved by following one framework instead of individual states’ EPR laws, according to an economic analysis from World Wildlife Fund and SC Johnson.

title: EFS, Merlin, GreenWaste, Valemi get flex film recycling contracts
summary: The US Flexible Film Initiative says it has moved more than 3 million pounds of flexible plastic packaging from California collection programs to reclaimers in the U.S. and Canada for processing.

title: Federal legislation would nix PFAS in food packaging
summary: This is the second time around for the Keep Food Containers Safe from PFAS Act. More than a dozen states have already passed laws restricting PFAS in packaging, but the federal government so far hasn’t taken such action.

title: Newsom vetoes recycled content claims bill, blaming ‘economic headwinds’
summary: In another win for industry groups, the California governor said he didn’t want to “unduly burden manufacturers and suppliers” already affected by recent trade policy changes.

title: Private label brands embrace own identities in packaging design
summary: Nearly a quarter of brands sold in retail stores now are private labels. Packaging manufacturers and designers have a bigger opportunity to participate in a growing segment — or help incumbents stand out.

title: NAW to appeal ruling that upheld Oregon EPR law
summary: “The district court reached the wrong legal conclusions, and we’re asking the Ninth Circuit to correct them,” said National Association of Wholesaler-Distributors CEO Eric Hoplin.

title: Nestlé breaks down its path to 2030 for virgin plastic reduction
summary: The food and beverage giant expects over half of its targeted virgin plastic decrease will come from upping recycled content. Nestlé previously focused on a 2025 recyclability target, of which it achieved about 90%.

title: ProAmpac comes in hot with grab-and-go wings box
summary: The supplier designed and produced a unique hot box for Flamin’ Hot chicken wings in Circle K stores. Hot-hold solutions are outpacing demand for chilled, prepared foods, said Adam Grose, executive vice president at ProAmpac.

title: Pratt, Amcor, JBM, O-I invest in manufacturing expansions
summary: Supremex, Sabert, Cirkla and Crawford Packaging also had announcements and openings across the Midwest and Southeast.

title: Circular Services acquisition bets on integrating reuse with recycling
summary: The Closed Loop Partners offshoot acquired Re:Dish. The long-term vision is that “we are offering reuse services everywhere that we provide recycling or food waste services today,” said Circular Services’ Jessica Long.

title: Blue Sage Capital plans to run the Frontier Waste playbook in Midwest
summary: The Texas-based private equity firm is looking to repeat prior success with the launch of Blue Castle Waste Solutions. The regional hauler has closed three acquisitions in Iowa and Minnesota so far.

title: EFS, Merlin, GreenWaste, Valemi get flex film recycling contracts
summary: The US Flexible Film Initiative says it has moved more than 3 million pounds of flexible plastic packaging from California collection programs to reclaimers in the U.S. and Canada for processing.

title: California approves labor-backed force majeure updates and other laws
summary: Gov. Newsom signed a union-backed bill updating hauler franchise labor rules, which comes a few years after vetoing a similar bill. He also approved bills related to carpet recycling, bottle bill fees and food waste prevention.

title: Newsom signs law banning single-use vapes that pose fire risk
summary: Waste and recycling groups support the ban to help curb vape-related facility fires caused by the devices’ batteries. Newsom also signed another vape-related bill meant to look into better disposal methods.

title: Oregon utility’s biogas projects with WM, Tyson stall
summary: NW Natural invested millions into a partnership with Tyson Foods for two digesters, one of which has shut down, per a report. WM has also confirmed a proposed landfill project with the utility is not moving forward.

title: Newsom vetoes recycled content claims bill, blaming ‘economic headwinds’
summary: In another win for industry groups, the California governor said he didn’t want to “unduly burden manufacturers and suppliers” already affected by recent trade policy changes.

title: New York City nearly doubles curbside organics capture, but has room to grow
summary: The Department of Sanitation saw progress in its most recent fiscal year. But a bump in participation from the initial enforcement period aborted last year was not repeated when enforcement restarted this spring.

title: Kanopy integrates recycling monitoring and AI tools under new parent company
summary: Recycle Coach and Re-Trac will become brands of Kanopy to streamline information and data services. It will launch a new waste information app, Curb Coach. Prairie Robotics will become a strategic partner.

title: Greyparrot, Circular Services, pilot AI technology at New York MRF
summary: Greyparrot says 89% of aluminum at Circular Services’ Sunset Park MRF is recoverable. The two companies plan to collaborate on projects at the site this fall.

title: Potential increase of AI-driven e-scrap higher than previously estimated
summary: A Basel Action Network report sought to include the entire universe of electronics used in AI applications, including servers and power supplies. Data sovereignty laws and upgrades could also increase tons generated.
